draft.title: Qwen3 30B A3B model gets stuck with 'thinking' enabled in Open WebUI—any known fixes?
draft.body: A user reported updating their local Open WebUI Docker setup and loading the 8.0 gguf quant of the Qwen3 30B A3B model without connection issues. Requests go through fine, and the 'thinking' progress bar appears as expected. However, when the 'thinking' feature is enabled, generation eventually halts mid-sentence and the progress indicator freezes indefinitely. Disabling 'thinking' allows normal responses. Interestingly, the same model works fine on other front ends like SillyTavern and VS Code extensions such as Continue and Clide. Given this, is anyone aware of compatibility nuances or configuration tweaks in Open WebUI that might prevent the generation from freezing with 'thinking' enabled on large models like Qwen3 30B A3B? Any insights on how to debug or work around this stuck state would be appreciated.
